```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Oncoplot for significant candidate driver genes from dNdScv
# Genes are taken from the dNdScv bar plot
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(maftools)
})

# -------------------------------
# Input MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

# -------------------------------
# Output directory
# -------------------------------

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/dNdScv_gene/"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------
# dNdScv significant candidate driver genes
# Listed in the bar plot
# -------------------------------

driver_genes <- c(
  "CDH1", "EIF1AX", "C18orf63", "GORASP1", "ADCY2", "CTNNA1", "PIK3CA", "GGT7", "TYW1", 
  "GNAQ", "TSPAN18", "NINJ2", "VPS39", "C9orf153", "MTMR2", "AGAP2", "RTKN", "CPLX2",
  "ZMYM3", "CD2BP2", "TDG", "ORM1", "ERVMER34-1", "DDO", "SYTL3", "TARS2", "FOXK1",
  "DLK2", "ZNF536", "THAP12", "JPH1", "ZNF831", "PHLDB3", "HSD17B14", "RBFOX1", "MEOX1"
)

# -------------------------------
# Read MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_dt <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE
)

required_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf_dt))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in MAF: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# Check which genes are present in MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_genes <- unique(maf_dt$Hugo_Symbol)

genes_present <- driver_genes[driver_genes %in% maf_genes]
genes_missing <- setdiff(driver_genes, maf_genes)

message("Total dNdScv candidate genes: ", length(driver_genes))
message("Genes present in MAF: ", length(genes_present))
message("Genes missing from MAF: ", length(genes_missing))

if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
  message("Missing genes:")
  message(paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
  stop("None of the dNdScv candidate genes are present in the MAF.")
}

# -------------------------------
# Save gene presence table
# -------------------------------

gene_check_dt <- data.table(
  Hugo_Symbol = driver_genes,
  Present_in_MAF = driver_genes %in% maf_genes
)

fwrite(
  gene_check_dt,
  file.path(out_dir, "dNdScv_candidate_driver_genes_MAF_presence_check.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# -------------------------------
# Read MAF using maftools
# -------------------------------

maf_obj <- read.maf(
  maf = maf_file,
  useAll = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# -------------------------------
# Save oncoplot PDF
# -------------------------------

pdf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "dNdScv_candidate_driver_genes_oncoplot.pdf"
)

pdf(
  pdf_file,
  width = 22,
  height = 14,
  onefile = FALSE
)

oncoplot(
  maf = maf_obj,
  genes = genes_present,
  keepGeneOrder = TRUE,
  removeNonMutated = FALSE,
  sortByMutation = FALSE,
  showTumorSampleBarcodes = TRUE,
  draw_titv = FALSE,
  fontSize = 1.1,
  SampleNamefontSize = 1.5,
  titleFontSize = 1.4,
  legendFontSize = 1.2,
  barcode_mar = 12,
  gene_mar = 10,
  barcodeSrt = 90,
  titleText = "Significant candidate driver genes by dNdScv"
)

dev.off()

# -------------------------------
# Save oncoplot PNG
# -------------------------------

png_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "dNdScv_candidate_driver_genes_oncoplot.png"
)

png(
  png_file,
  width = 6600,
  height = 4200,
  res = 300
)

oncoplot(
  maf = maf_obj,
  genes = genes_present,
  keepGeneOrder = TRUE,
  removeNonMutated = FALSE,
  sortByMutation = FALSE,
  showTumorSampleBarcodes = TRUE,
  draw_titv = FALSE,
  fontSize = 1.1,
  SampleNamefontSize = 1.5,
  barcodeSrt = 90,
  barcode_mar = 12,
  gene_mar = 10,
  titleFontSize = 1.4,
  legendFontSize = 1.1,
  titleText = "Significant candidate driver genes by dNdScv"
)

dev.off()

# -------------------------------
# Done
# -------------------------------

message("Oncoplot saved:")
message(pdf_file)
message(png_file)
```
